SELECT m.id, m.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.cf_rating AS cfRating, u.school, m.role, m.status, m.pending_kind AS pendingKind, m.joined_time AS joinedTime FROM team_member m INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE m.team_post_id = #{teamPostId} ORDER BY m.status DESC, m.joined_time ASC
